adjudication.rationale: In `admin-group.js.es6`, the new `addMembers` action includes a `// TODO: should clear the input` comment and only calls `this.get("model").addMembers(this.get("usernames"));` without ever resetting `this.set("usernames", ...)`. Since the template binds `{{user-selector usernames=usernames ...}}`, the entered usernames will remain in the input after adding. This is a real, diff-grounded UX/incompleteness issue, but not a clearly verifiable correctness defect from the diff alone.
